chapters.screen: Naive Bayes. Naive Bayes never searches for a boundary. It counts: how common survival is, and what ages and fares look like in each group. Watch its estimates, and its map, firm up as it sees more passengers.
chapters.spoken: Naive Bayes. Naive Bayes never searches for a boundary. It counts: how common survival is, and what ages and fares look like in each group. Watch its estimates, and its map, firm up as it sees more passengers.

chapters.screen: Each mark is one passenger: age (x) and fare paid (y, log scale); women on the left, men on the right. Blue dots survived, red crosses did not.
chapters.spoken: Each mark is one passenger: age and fare paid on a log scale; women on the left, men on the right. Blue dots survived, red crosses did not.

chapters.screen: After only a handful of passengers the bell curves are guesses, and so is the map. Shading is the model's P(survive).
chapters.spoken: After only a handful of passengers the bell curves are guesses, and so is the map. Shading is the model's chance of survival.

chapters.screen: Each frame counts more passengers (partial_fit). The panel shows the per-class bell curves for age and fare; 'naive' means each input is treated as independent.
chapters.spoken: Each frame counts more passengers. The panel shows the per-class bell curves for age and fare; 'naive' means each input is treated as independent.

chapters.screen: All 627 passengers counted: train accuracy 77%, validation 77%. Being a woman is by far the strongest evidence for survival.
chapters.spoken: All 627 passengers counted: train accuracy 77%, validation 77%. Being a woman is by far the strongest evidence for survival.

chapters.screen: For an unseen passenger, multiply the prior by how likely their age, fare and sex are under each class, then normalise the two numbers into a probability.
chapters.spoken: For an unseen passenger, multiply the prior by how likely their age, fare and sex are under each class, then normalise the two numbers into a probability.

chapters.screen: Final exam: the trained model judges all 210 test passengers it has never seen. Wrong calls are circled on the maps and crossed in the grid, grouped by class of travel.
chapters.spoken: Final exam: the trained model judges all 210 test passengers it has never seen. Wrong calls are circled on the maps and crossed in the grid, grouped by class of travel.

chapters.screen: Naive Bayes multiplies one bell curve per input, so each sheet is smooth and curved. Height is the model's P(survive), one sheet per sex, seen by a swinging camera.
chapters.spoken: Naive Bayes multiplies one bell curve per input, so each sheet is smooth and curved. Height is the model's chance of survival, one sheet per sex, seen by a swinging camera.

chapters.screen: About the same: 77% with every input against 80% with age, fare and sex.
chapters.spoken: About the same: 77% with every input against 80% with age, fare and sex.

chapters.screen: Naive Bayes is counting made principled: priors times per-feature likelihoods, normalised by Bayes' rule. Limitation: it assumes the inputs are independent within each class, which real ages and fares are not quite, and bell curves fit skewed fares and 0/1 sex only roughly.
chapters.spoken: Naive Bayes is counting made principled: priors times per-feature likelihoods, normalised by Bayes' rule. Limitation: it assumes the inputs are independent within each class, which real ages and fares are not quite, and bell curves fit skewed fares and 0-or-1 sex only roughly.
